This '''creature''' was an [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]] owned by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] when he was young.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>

When Darklighter first took ownership of the anooba, it was half wild due to the abuse inflicted by the former owner. It took months of kind treatment before the anooba started feeling safe in the Darklighter household and stopped snapping at everyone.<ref name="Razor's Edge" />
